ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.2; high-intensity pixels dominate the lateral lobe fields while low-intensity pixels are concentrated in the central peduncle-interface region and along the distal-lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity blob bifurcating into lateral fields of higher intensity. High-intensity fields are interrupted by low-intensity linear vectors and localized high-intensity circular nodes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation; interior pixel angle approximately 48 degrees with a significant vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge showing high-frequency serrations (approx. 5-10 pixel amplitude) interspersed with several large-scale indentations on the inner trailing margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lower boundary curve; trailing edge follows a generally sigmoid path from notch to tip, exhibiting significant jaggedness and upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several distinct high-intensity annular rings clustered near the median notch and at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense array of low-intensity linear segments. Right lobe displays at least 6 parallel vertical rake marks; left lobe displays 2 prominent isolated vertical tracks and numerous smaller intersecting scars.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks covering approximately 30% of the visible surface area; significant erosion and non-uniform jaggedness of the trailing edge boundary suggests cumulative physical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent, high-contrast white circular focal points situated symmetrically on either side of the median notch base.
